entry: Recipe — Cooking p3 into a rhythmic phrase
claim: § What you should hear: "p3 grooves ... it feels like it's turning", and reflection flattens while rotation propels. The method (shift by +4 mod 12) makes a period-4 loop, so the felt 'turning' is the claim to test.

pieces.what: Plays the p3 recipe output beside a plain 4-step loop and beside a mirrored (pm) version of the same cell, so the reader can judge whether 'turning' is heard or named
The recipe's break (one hit removed in sector 2) played against the same break in a pm phrase, testing 'the breach bleeds further' without reflection
